purpose: Records artifacts that this repository deliberately does not redistribute, so that a reader can verify they hold the same bytes the analysis used without those bytes being republished here.

source.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
source.publisher: US National Library of Medicine, National Institutes of Health
source.access: v2 API, complete registry snapshot, 601694 study records
conditions_observed: No proprietary rights asserted over any portion of the database
source.why_record_content_is_not_redistributed: The Terms state that ClinicalTrials.gov data carry an international copyright outside the United States and its Territories or Possessions, and that some data may be subject to the copyright of third parties. The derived tables below contain registered text authored by study sponsors, so they are not republished.

not_redistributed.what: Free-text extraction for 9,484 AI/ML studies; 28 columns, including up to 2,195 characters of registered text per study.
not_redistributed.origin: Built by src/02_extract_evidence_text.py from the registry snapshot.

not_redistributed.what: Scored corpus, 9,484 rows x 122 columns: CURA scores alongside the structured registry fields they were read from, including brief_title and lead_sponsor.
not_redistributed.reason: Carries verbatim registry fields alongside the derived scores.

not_redistributed.what: Structured registry fields for the 9,484 matched studies; 39 columns.
The 200-case stratified sample with a short registered-text excerpt per case.
not_redistributed.reason: Contains registry text excerpts. Supplied to the journal as supplementary material for peer review; the labels and scores for the same 200 cases ARE in this repository.

not_redistributed.what: Raster copies of the six figures.
not_redistributed.reason: The vector PDFs in figures/ are the canonical copies; the rasters regenerate from the scripts.
